item.title: Troop deployments to U.S. cities cost nearly half a billion dollars in 2025
item.description: The Trump administration’s deployment of troops to five different U.S. cities last year cost roughly $496 million through the end of December, according to estimates released by the Congressional Budget Office this week. item.title: UTC Gets 10th Straight Win With 72-59 Victory Over Mercer
item.description: (gomocs.com) Behind a dominant second quarter, Chattanooga defeated Mercer 72-59, in its first home game in nearly three weeks. item.title: McCallie Ends Nine Game Losing Streak to Baylor With 46-45 Victory
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) McCallie ended their nine game series losing streak to rival Baylor on Friday with a 46-45 win at the Red Raiders Duke Arena. Ernas Valauskas hit a three with roughly ten seconds to play give Big Blue the one point victory. Valauskas led McCallie with 17 points. Taheim Elohem paced Baylor with 14 points. item.title: North Cobb Christian Defeats LFO 61-58 in Region Showdown
item.description: Fort Oglethorpe, GA-(WDEF-TV) In a region showdown on Friday night at LFO, North Cobb Christian held off the Warriors 61-58. It was a battle of the region’s top two teams. The Eagles remain unbeaten in region play with the win, while the Warriors drop to 10-3 in region action. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
